summary: African by birth, currently living in Australia, previously lived in the U.S., software engineer with expertise in compiler construction, systems programming, and embedded systems, strong interest in Lisp and functional programming, active in online programming communities, politically critical of government and corporate influence, has a girlfriend who is a musician, enjoys DIY projects and urban farming, multilingual (speaks English, Arabic, and possibly other languages), has experience with startups and freelancing, values self-education and open-source software, critical of mainstream education and corporate culture.
